name: Multi-View Regulated Gaussian Splatting
definition: A plug-and-play optimizer for 3D Gaussian Splatting that imposes multi-view coherent (MVC) constraints throughout the optimization process to enhance multi-view consistency and ensure smoother gradient updates, addressing the unstable gradients caused by single-view optimization paradigms.
summary: Multi-View Regulated Gaussian Splatting is a plug-and-play training optimization that aggregates gradients from multiple views to stabilize convergence and enhance consistency without architectural changes.
